ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: There are five leaves in the image, labeled B, D, C, E, and A, respectively. Label B is located on the far left; the leaf above it is overall relatively long, greater than its width, with the widest part near the middle, gradually narrowing toward the tip and the base, and the outline is elliptical. According to leaf-shape classification rules, a long elliptical leaf with the widest part near the middle belongs to elliptic. Therefore, the leaf type of Label B is Elliptic.
